clean_noninferiority: upper confidence bound on clean loss below margin
family_effects: one-way fixed-effect ANOVA F-test on paired degradation
fixed_panel_pooled_degradation: paired mean over fixed model-task cells with two-sided Wald confidence interval
per_model_paired_degradation: paired mean(clean minus intervention) with two-sided Wald confidence interval
raac_improvement: paired mean(RAAC minus standard) with lower confidence bound above zero
rank_instability: paired task bootstrap probability of any rank reversal
unresolved_ranking: simultaneous 95 percent intervals overlap for at least one adjacent pair
